data.title: task list leaves history out; task show is where it lives
data.why: history was 61% of the response at 4000 tasks and 68% in this repository, which put task list --json at 42k tokens against the 25k at which an agent's tool output is silently truncated - the agent sees a complete-looking answer that is missing tasks, and cannot tell. The schema had always placed history in task show; only the emission disagreed, and test/json-contract.test.ts pinned the wrong side of that disagreement. This repository's task list --json is now 13k tokens, complete rather than cut. Asking by name still works: --fields id,history returns it, and task show is unchanged.
data.rejected: Leaving history and relying on a default limit alone: the limit would have to be three times smaller to fit the same budget, so an agent would see a third as many tasks per call.; Removing it from board --json too: the schema explicitly promises every task in full there, so that would be breaking a promise rather than keeping one.
